title: Jacques de Fonteny, Livre d'Enigmes: manuscript of an early 17th-century para-emblematic sonnet sequence (HAB Wolfenbüttel)
institution: Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel; transcription and commentary by Gerhard F. Strasser
author: Jacques de Fonteny
notes: Manuscript (HAB Cod. Guelf. 117.5 Extrav.) of sonnet riddles, each with an engraving; the edition gives an original-spelling transcription with variants, a regularised version, introduction, commentary and facsimile. Readable and downloadable without login: the TEI files tei-transcript-fr-or.xml (original spelling) and tei-transcript-fr.xml are served from the HAB server. The edition is dated 2012 and the TEI file was last modified on 2012-08-21, so it is marked archived. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
